branchify.command.showLineCommit: Show Commit Details for Current Line
branchify.command.showPersonalStats: Show My Personal Impact & Branch Stats
branchify.config.title: Branchify
branchify.config.inlineBlame.enabled: Show author and commit information at the end of the current active line.
branchify.config.inlineBlame.delay: Debounce delay (ms) before computing inline blame after cursor movement.
branchify.config.avatars.enabled: Enable author profile picture and avatar resolution in hover and graph cards.
branchify.config.avatars.service: Avatar provider to resolve author profile pictures by email.
branchify.config.graph.pageSize: Maximum number of commits loaded per page in the graph view.
branchify.config.graph.density: Row height and density of the commit graph table (compact, comfortable, spacious).
branchify.config.graph.theme: Color theme for Branchify: auto (match VS Code), dark, or light.
branchify.config.graph.animations: Enable smooth motion choreography, pulse dots, and micro-interactions in the graph.
branchify.config.language: Language for Branchify interface (auto, es, en).
branchify.config.sync.autoFetch: Periodically poll remote repository changes in background.
branchify.config.sync.fetchIntervalMinut: Auto-fetch interval in minutes (0 to disable).
branchify.config.sync.notifyOnBranchMerg: Notify when a branch is merged or remote has new commits and ask before pull.
branchify.config.sync.askBeforePull: Show confirmation dialog before executing git pull.
